verdict.rationale: GlitchTip ships no SDKs of its own. It relies on Sentry's open-source SDKs and aims to be Sentry API compatible, and community users confirm the Sentry reporter ecosystem, including Svelte, works reliably with it. Debug-symbol upload for dSYM/PDB/ELF and JS source-map tooling hint at native and frontend coverage. Missing for 10: first-party GlitchTip SDKs, explicit documentation of mobile SDK support, explicit evidence of automatic uncaught-error capture, and per-platform setup docs for frontend, backend and mobile.
